name: agent-supervisor
title: A supervisor that routes work between a researcher and a coder

comparison.purpose: A supervisor model picks which worker runs next (a researcher looking up sample product notes, or a coder computing sums and averages over them) until it finishes with an answer. Guards cap each worker at two reports and reject FINISH before any worker has reported, and a turn budget replaces recursion_limit with a failed final state.
